automotive-ev-battery.title: Sila secures billion-dollar offtake agreement with Panasonic
automotive-ev-battery.summary: US battery material manufacturer Sila has secured a multi-year supply agreement with Panasonic Energy valued at over one billion US dollars for its silicon-carbon anode material, Titan Silicon. This strategic partnership strengthens Sila's position in advanced battery materials and supports Panasonic's EV battery production capacity.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Alpitronic builds DC fast charger factory in South Carolina, USA
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Alpitronic is investing nearly US$34 million to establish a dedicated manufacturing facility for DC fast-charging stations in South Carolina, marking a significant expansion of its US operations. The company has also appointed Christopher Balcom as Chief Commercial Officer to strengthen its North American management team.

automotive-ev-battery.title: POSCO expands lithium business with major order from CATL
automotive-ev-battery.summary: South Korean industrial conglomerate POSCO has secured a three-year supply contract with Chinese battery leader CATL extending through 2028 to provide lithium for electric vehicle batteries. The agreement underscores POSCO's strategic strengthening of its market position in the critical Chinese EV battery supply chain.

automotive-ev-battery.title: 'Nova': Moment Energy launches second-life battery storage system
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Canadian battery technology firm Moment Energy has unveiled Nova, an innovative battery energy storage system constructed from repurposed EV batteries, now in production at its Megafactory 1. Initial customer deliveries are scheduled for Q1 2027, demonstrating the growing commercial viability of second-life battery applications.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Envision AESC surpasses production volume milestone for 46120 battery cells
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Chinese battery manufacturer Envision AESC has achieved a significant production milestone, delivering over 10 million units of its cylindrical 46120 battery cells since series production commenced in July 2026. The BMW iX5 has been confirmed as the first model to integrate these high-performance cylindrical cells.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Tesla opens its first public Megacharger in Texas
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Tesla has opened its first public Megacharger location in Mesquite, Texas, east of Dallas, featuring eight high-powered charging stalls capable of delivering up to 1.2 MW each. The facility extends Tesla's public truck charging network into one of the largest freight markets in the United States.

automotive-ev-battery.title: TotalEnergies to install 1,500 EV charging points in London
automotive-ev-battery.summary: TotalEnergies has been selected to deploy over 1,500 new public EV charging points across the London Borough of Tower Hamlets over the next four years with government LEVI scheme funding. This marks the first London charging infrastructure contract to receive support from the Government's Low Emission Vehicle Infrastructure programme.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Leapmotor Produces Its 2 Millionth EV
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Chinese EV startup Leapmotor has achieved a significant production milestone with its 2 millionth electric vehicle, demonstrating remarkable growth in the competitive Chinese EV market and expanding international presence. The company's rapid scaling underscores the accelerating adoption of electric vehicles globally.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Compact premium: first drive in the new Audi A2 e-tron
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Audi has launched the A2 e-tron, a new compact premium electric vehicle designed to replace both the A1 and Q2 models based on the Volkswagen Group's MEB platform. The model is offered with both a 125 kW entry-level variant and a 240 kW top-tier version.

automotive-ev-battery.title: 2027 Bentley Torcal eSUVs sell out
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Bentley has announced that all units of its new Torcal electric luxury SUV allocated for 2027 production are already sold out, marking the successful market reception of the brand's first pure electric vehicle before manufacturing commences. The strong presales demand indicates robust consumer interest in premium EV offerings.

tech-ai.title: Anthropic's 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
tech-ai.summary: Anthropic completed a landmark IPO at $83 per share, valuing the company at nearly $105 billion and generating approximately $280 million in proceeds for each of its seven founders. The record-breaking valuation underscores the intense investor appetite for frontier AI companies and positions Anthropic as a major player in the competitive AI market.

tech-ai.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
tech-ai.summary: Apple is reportedly building its own AI agent capable of performing a range of tasks including web browsing, cross-app integration, and code writing, positioning itself to compete with established players like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta. The move signals Apple's commitment to integrating advanced AI capabilities into its Mac ecosystem.

tech-ai.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
tech-ai.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following an affair, an event that could have significant implications for U.S. national security as the country competes with China in advanced AI infrastructure development. The leadership change at one of the world's most critical AI chip manufacturers represents a major corporate governance issue with geopolitical ramifications.

tech-ai.title: A brief history of Nvidia's recent stock fluctuations
tech-ai.summary: Nvidia's stock price has plummeted approximately 40 percent from its October 6th all-time high to around $150 per share, despite interim CEO Colette Kress expressing confidence during the company's latest earnings call. The dramatic decline reflects investor concerns about the chip manufacturer's competitive positioning and broader market volatility in the semiconductor sector.

tech-ai.title: Anthropic rival says companies can (mostly) skip the pricey models
tech-ai.summary: Fireworks AI's co-founder countered Anthropic's record IPO by promoting open-source AI models as a cost-effective alternative to premium proprietary systems. The statement highlights growing market competition and efforts to democratize access to capable AI models at lower price points.

tech-ai.title: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
tech-ai.summary: Google has updated its search homepage to integrate AI chat functionality directly into the search experience through a collapsible sidebar. The feature allows users to access and continue previous AI conversations without leaving the homepage, further embedding AI assistance into Google's core product.

tech-ai.title: Meta's new Muse Charm device may cost $300
tech-ai.summary: Meta is reportedly pricing its upcoming Muse Charm AI wearable device at $300, though the company has not officially confirmed the price or delivery timeline beyond its previous holiday season target. The device is designed to provide access to Meta's Muse AI agent with real-time voice and avatar technology.

tech-ai.title: These tech outages are giving Y2K, AI agent style
tech-ai.summary: Recent outages affecting airline booking systems, banking platforms, and productivity tools may indicate a deeper systemic issue related to AI agents rather than coincidental failures, according to cybersecurity experts. The pattern of simultaneous infrastructure failures raises concerns about potential vulnerabilities in AI-dependent systems.

tech-ai.title: Anthropic's IPO could deliver $156B to charity
tech-ai.summary: At current stock valuations, Anthropic's Public Benefit Foundation structure combined with employee donations and company matching could potentially generate approximately $156 billion in charitable contributions. The arrangement reflects the company's commitment to ensuring AI development benefits society broadly.

tech-ai.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX has a plan to eliminate cell phone dead zones
tech-ai.summary: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced that the company has completed the design of a miniature rooftop cell tower intended to eliminate cellular coverage dead zones and improve mobile phone reception. The technology could represent a significant infrastructure solution for connectivity challenges in underserved areas.

science-space.title: NASA's Voyager 1 Makes History Reaching One Light-Day From Earth
science-space.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 probe has achieved a historic milestone, reaching one light-day (approximately 16.1 billion miles) from Earth after more than 49 years of continuous travel. The achievement marks a significant moment in human space exploration, demonstrating the remarkable longevity and reach of humanity's most distant spacecraft.

science-space.title: NASA Science Data Powers New Method to Discover Hard-to-Find Pulsars
science-space.summary: An international team of scientists has developed a pulsar detection method approximately one million times faster than previous techniques, utilizing open data from NASA's Fermi mission. This breakthrough significantly advances astronomical research capabilities and demonstrates the value of open-access scientific data for accelerating discovery.

science-space.title: The View from the Tower: Watch Starship Come in for Chopsticks Catch in Epic Slo-Mo Video
science-space.summary: New high-speed video footage provides a tower perspective of SpaceX's first-ever catch of a Starship upper stage, a landmark achievement in reusable rocket technology. The footage captures the precision and complexity of the innovative booster capture technique that represents a major advancement in spaceflight operations.

science-space.title: China Rolls Out Rocket for Launch of 1st International Astronaut to Tiangong Space Station
science-space.summary: China has rolled out the launch vehicle and spacecraft for its Shenzhou-24 mission, which will transport the first international astronaut to visit the nation's Tiangong space station. The mission represents a significant step in international space cooperation and the expansion of China's human spaceflight program.

science-space.title: NASA Conducts Latest RS-25 Engine Test in Support of Future Artemis Missions
science-space.summary: NASA successfully tested the RS-25 engine for the planned three-minute duration at the Stennis Space Center, advancing preparations for future Artemis lunar missions. The developmental engine testing validates critical propulsion systems that will support NASA's efforts to return humans to the Moon.

science-space.title: No More Asteroid Landing: Engine Trouble Forces Japan's Hayabusa2 Probe to Change Plans
science-space.summary: Japan's space agency has revised the final objectives of its Hayabusa2 asteroid mission due to ion thruster malfunctions that prevent the originally planned landing. The mission adaptation demonstrates the challenges of long-duration space operations and engineers' ability to adjust scientific goals while maintaining mission value.

science-space.title: El Niño Rains Paint the Atacama
science-space.summary: Winter precipitation driven by El Niño conditions has revived dormant seeds across northern Chile's Atacama Desert, resulting in what may be the most extensive flowering event recorded by satellite imagery in the region. The rare phenomenon demonstrates the dramatic ecological responses triggered by significant weather pattern shifts.

science-space.title: Leonid Meteor Shower Thrills Stargazers Worldwide with Colorful Sky Show
science-space.summary: The Leonid meteor shower delivered a spectacular display this year, featuring vibrant meteors and luminous trails visible from locations around the world. The annual celestial event provided widespread public engagement with astronomical phenomena and opportunities for amateur observation.

science-space.title: Voyager 1 Team, Unbowed by Communications Glitch, Celebrates Epic 1-Light-Day Distance Milestone
science-space.summary: The Voyager 1 team celebrated the spacecraft's one-light-day distance achievement while managing recent communication anomalies affecting the probe. Despite technical challenges, the team continues to demonstrate resilience in maintaining operations for humanity's most distant spacecraft.

science-space.title: Challenge: Public Input on Life and the World in 2075
science-space.summary: NASA's Transformational Tools and Technologies program is soliciting public input on conceptual ideas about life in 2075, focusing on how future aviation and aerospace systems may evolve. The challenge offers $20,000 in awards and encourages broad public participation in envisioning humanity's technological future.

world-news.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
world-news.summary: The International Court of Justice issued an unprecedented verdict finding Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority in a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands. This landmark ruling has significant implications for international humanitarian law and accountability for mass atrocities.

world-news.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
world-news.summary: The leaders of the United States, Russia, and China held their first trilateral meeting and issued a joint peace declaration. This unprecedented diplomatic engagement among the three major powers represents a significant geopolitical development with potential global implications.

world-news.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
world-news.summary: European allies of Ukraine announced they have adopted a united negotiating position ahead of discussions on ending the war, as leaders convened at a summit in Berlin. The coordinated approach signals potential movement toward diplomatic resolution of the conflict.

world-news.title: UK and EU to agree youth mobility scheme, BBC understands
world-news.summary: The UK and EU are expected to approve a new youth mobility scheme at Friday's bilateral summit, alongside deals addressing food trade and carbon emissions. The agreement marks a significant step in post-Brexit cooperation on key policy areas.

world-news.title: Meta rethinks 2030 climate goals as AI data centres drive emissions up
world-news.summary: Meta announced it is reviewing its 2030 sustainability targets as rising energy consumption from AI data centres threatens to increase overall corporate emissions. The decision reflects a broader industry challenge in balancing rapid AI expansion with climate commitments.

world-news.title: Asia's stock markets dive as Anthropic debut fails to allay AI bubble fears
world-news.summary: Major stock indexes across Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and Hong Kong declined following Anthropic's public market debut amid concerns about an artificial intelligence sector bubble. The market reaction underscores ongoing investor anxiety about AI valuations in global financial markets.

world-news.title: Thousands protest Colombia's tax plans amid row over US military role
world-news.summary: Large demonstrations by trade unions, students, and opposition groups took place across Colombian cities to protest government tax proposals and disputed US military involvement. The protests reflect domestic political tensions with international dimensions.

world-news.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': People inside besieged Yemeni city speak to BBC
world-news.summary: Civilians trapped in the Yemeni city of Taiz, besieged by Houthi forces, described daily hardships and survival strategies in interviews with the BBC. The accounts provide insight into the humanitarian consequences of Yemen's ongoing conflict.

world-news.title: 'Completely messed up everything': Malawi's fuel crisis causes chaos
world-news.summary: Malawi faces a severe fuel shortage that has disrupted transportation and business operations across the country. The crisis threatens economic stability and daily services for the southern African nation.

world-news.title: Haiti police say 34 gang members killed in capital raid
world-news.summary: Haitian police conducted a major security operation in Port-au-Prince that resulted in the deaths of 34 alleged gang members. The operation reflects ongoing efforts to address gang violence and instability in the Caribbean nation.

finance-markets.title: Stocks Set for Worst Run Since 2023, Havens Gain: Markets Wrap
finance-markets.summary: Global equity markets are experiencing their longest losing streak in over three years as the artificial intelligence trade has collapsed following an extended bull run, prompting investors to shift capital into safe-haven assets including US Treasuries and the dollar. The broad-based selloff reflects mounting concerns about AI valuations and broader economic headwinds affecting major markets worldwide.

finance-markets.title: Tech stocks fall as Anthropic IPO fails to stem broader AI sell-off
finance-markets.summary: Despite Anthropic's record $81 billion listing on Wall Street, technology stocks declined globally as investors remain concerned about the broader artificial intelligence sector's valuations and growth prospects. Asian markets followed US equities lower, indicating that even a major AI company's successful public debut was insufficient to reverse negative market momentum.

finance-markets.title: Anthropic shares jump 17% after record Wall Street listing
finance-markets.summary: Anthropic, the AI company led by Dario Amodei, completed a record-breaking public offering that raised $81 billion in an upsized deal, with shares surging 17 percent on the company's first trading day. The successful IPO marks a major milestone for the artificial intelligence sector despite broader market volatility affecting tech stocks.

finance-markets.title: Copper Rout Deepens as AI Selloff Wreaks Havoc in Metals Markets
finance-markets.summary: Copper prices have plummeted to their lowest level since March amid broader market turbulence triggered by intensifying concerns about global demand weakness linked to the artificial intelligence trade collapse. The dramatic selloff in industrial metals signals potential weakness in economic growth expectations and reduced demand for raw materials.

finance-markets.title: Hong Kong Stocks Fall 20% From 2026 High as AI Selloff Spreads
finance-markets.summary: Hong Kong's stock market has declined 20 percent from its 2026 peak as the artificial intelligence sector selloff broadens to impact even defensive equity segments. The sharp decline underscores the pervasive nature of current market downturn affecting major Asian financial centers.

finance-markets.title: Taiwan Stocks Face Worst Week Since 1991 Despite Support Steps
finance-markets.summary: Taiwan's tech-heavy stock market experienced severe losses in its worst week since 1991, as the global artificial intelligence trade deteriorated further and demand for semiconductors weakened. Despite efforts by authorities to provide market support, the selloff reflects deep investor concerns about the AI sector's sustainability and technology spending outlook.

finance-markets.title: AMD shares fall after short seller report on China links
finance-markets.summary: Advanced Micro Devices shares declined as much as 11 percent following a short seller report from Hunterbrook raising concerns about the chipmaker's connections to China, in the wake of recent scrutiny surrounding Nvidia's business practices. The selloff reflects broader investor sensitivity to geopolitical risks and regulatory uncertainty affecting semiconductor companies with Chinese exposure.

finance-markets.title: PBOC Anchors Yuan With Stable Fix as Volatility Jumps After APEC
finance-markets.summary: China's central bank signaled its intention to stabilize the yuan through a steady fixing despite elevated currency volatility following a trilateral leaders' meeting at APEC, after the currency experienced its largest decline since March. The policy intervention underscores Beijing's commitment to managing exchange rate stability amid broader market turbulence.

finance-markets.title: US approved sale of Nvidia and AMD chips to Chinese companies
finance-markets.summary: The Pentagon approved the sale of advanced Nvidia and AMD semiconductor chips to certain Chinese companies, though concerns arose regarding some recipients' potential associations with the People's Liberation Army. The approvals highlight the complex balancing act between maintaining US technological competitiveness and national security considerations in the semiconductor sector.

finance-markets.title: AI Spurs Funding Needs as Top Japan Power Producer Weighs IPO
finance-markets.summary: Japan's leading electricity producer is considering an initial public offering as part of a broader strategy to raise capital for infrastructure expansion, citing strong investment demand driven by the artificial intelligence sector's substantial power consumption requirements. The potential IPO reflects growing recognition of energy infrastructure investments as beneficiaries of the AI computing boom.

health-biotech.title: Sanofi's Infilbray wins first approval for neurological symptoms of Gaucher
health-biotech.summary: Sanofi received FDA approval for Infilbray (venglustat), the first drug to treat neurological symptoms of Gaucher disease, a rare genetic disorder. The approval represents a significant advancement in treating a previously unaddressed manifestation of this lysosomal storage disease.

health-biotech.title: Regeneron enters neurology field as FDA approves siRNA for myasthenia gravis
health-biotech.summary: Regeneron's siRNA therapy cemdisiran, now branded as Livsayis, received FDA approval for myasthenia gravis, marking the second new drug approved for this autoimmune disorder within a week. The approval expands Regeneron's presence in the neurology field with a novel RNA-based therapeutic approach.

health-biotech.title: Lilly starts work on Pennsylvania obesity plant; ITM, AtomVie strike supply deal
health-biotech.summary: Eli Lilly commenced construction on a $3.5 billion manufacturing facility in Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania, to produce obesity drugs including its retatrutide program. The plant investment reflects major pharmaceutical industry commitment to obesity treatment capacity amid surging demand.

health-biotech.title: Sanofi considering a deal to acquire Insmed, according to report
health-biotech.summary: Sanofi is reportedly evaluating an acquisition of Insmed, which would represent one of the largest biopharma takeovers in recent years. The potential deal underscores continued consolidation activity in the pharmaceutical sector as major companies expand their portfolios.

health-biotech.title: AbbVie and Disco strike deal worth up to $2.54B for solid tumor targets
health-biotech.summary: AbbVie partnered with preclinical cancer biotech Disco Pharmaceuticals in a collaboration valued at up to $2.54 billion to advance antibody-drug conjugate and T cell engager programs. The deal demonstrates continued investment in next-generation oncology approaches.

health-biotech.title: Big drugmakers tell House committee they will halt clinical trials at some hospitals in China
health-biotech.summary: Major pharmaceutical companies informed a U.S. House committee of plans to suspend clinical trial operations at certain Chinese hospitals amid security and regulatory concerns. The move reflects heightened geopolitical tensions and compliance challenges in international drug development.

health-biotech.title: Study raises doubts about combining vaccine, monoclonal antibody to protect against malaria
health-biotech.summary: Research findings suggest that combining a monoclonal antibody with a new malaria vaccine may reduce effectiveness in infants, despite the antibody's individual promise in malaria prevention. The study highlights important drug-drug interaction considerations for combination immunization strategies.

health-biotech.title: Novartis details eczema win, autoimmune CAR-T efforts after rocky quarter
health-biotech.summary: Novartis reported mid-stage success with its eczema drug candidate and announced plans to restart trials of its autoimmune CAR-T cell therapy while slightly adjusting sales guidance. The developments provide updates on the company's pipeline progress following a challenging financial quarter.

health-biotech.title: Pharmalittle: We're reading about a Merck AI deal, China and the pharma supply chain, and more
health-biotech.summary: Merck entered a research collaboration with Isomorphic Labs, an AI drug discovery company built on Nobel Prize-winning technology. The partnership reflects pharmaceutical industry focus on artificial intelligence applications for drug design and development.

health-biotech.title: National Academies report calls for faster decisions on publication retractions and corrections
health-biotech.summary: The National Academies urged the scientific community to accelerate responses to data integrity concerns, including retractions and corrections of published research. The recommendation addresses growing challenges of research quality and credibility in the biomedical literature.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released updates addressing approximately 1,100 security vulnerabilities across Windows and supported software, including 63 critical flaws and a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook. The Patch Tuesday release comes alongside significant security updates from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.

cybersecurity.title: Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day Flaw Lets Network Attackers Bypass Authentication
cybersecurity.summary: A critical vulnerability in VMware vCenter allows attackers with network access to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the virtualization management system. Broadcom has released fixed versions for all supported branches with no available workaround.

cybersecurity.title: PHP Fixes 7 Critical Flaws, Including Bugs That Could Allow Remote Code Execution
cybersecurity.summary: The PHP Foundation released security updates addressing multiple critical vulnerabilities that could enable remote code execution on affected systems, including CVE-2026-115560. The patches address flaws affecting all supported PHP versions under specific conditions.

cybersecurity.title: CISA Warns of 4 Exploited Flaws Linked to Ransomware, Cryptomining, and LLMjacking Attacks
cybersecurity.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added four actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, affecting Synology DiskStation Manager, BerriAI LiteLLM, Apache Axis, and Vanderbilt University REDCap. These flaws are being leveraged in ransomware, cryptomining, and AI model hijacking campaigns.

cybersecurity.title: Everything Is a Web Application, Including Your Firewall
cybersecurity.summary: Palo Alto Networks confirmed that attackers were actively exploiting two critical PHP vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. The incident highlights the expansion of web-based attack surfaces to network security infrastructure.

cybersecurity.title: Hackers Breach N-able Cloud Server, Disrupting Email Security Management Across 3 Regions
cybersecurity.summary: N-able disclosed an unauthorized access incident affecting a Mail Assure and Spam Experts Hosted Cloud server, forcing the company to disable management interfaces and APIs across three regions. The company is actively investigating the breach and implementing hardening measures to prevent recurrence.

cybersecurity.title: Drupal Patches Critical Installer Flaw That Could Give Unauthenticated Attackers Control of Sites
cybersecurity.summary: Drupal released patches addressing a critical vulnerability in its core installer that allows unauthenticated attackers to reinstall sites under specific conditions, potentially leading to site takeover or remote code execution. The vulnerability affects uncommon configurations, and fixes are available for all supported branches.

cybersecurity.title: Ruby Releases Fixes for 7 Regex and String Flaws, Warns 5 Have Proof-of-Concept RCE
cybersecurity.summary: Ruby addressed seven memory-safety vulnerabilities in its regular expression engine and string case-conversion code, with maintainers confirming that proof-of-concept exploits exist for five flaws capable of triggering remote code execution. The updated versions are now available for download.

cybersecurity.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
cybersecurity.summary: The United Kingdom imposed economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a cryptocurrency platform serving as a major financial conduit for ransomware payments, narcotics trafficking, darknet markets, and cybercrime services. The action aims to disrupt Russia's ability to circumvent existing financial restrictions through cryptocurrency.

cybersecurity.title: Researcher Demonstrates Database RCE Exploits Affecting PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle
cybersecurity.summary: A security researcher published proof-of-concept exploits demonstrating how low-privilege database accounts can achieve remote code execution on PostgreSQL, MySQL, and ClickHouse systems by exploiting memory-corruption vulnerabilities in SQL engine code. The research highlights a significant attack vector bypassing traditional database access controls.

crypto-web3.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks 35% as $1.5 billion exits reserves after illicit-finance report
crypto-web3.summary: Sky Protocol's USDS stablecoin experienced a significant 35% contraction in reserves as a large holder linked to Poloniex withdrew approximately $1.5 billion in USDC backing. Despite the substantial outflow, USDS maintained its $1 peg, though the incident raises concerns about stablecoin reserve stability and potential regulatory scrutiny.

crypto-web3.title: Binance wins $6.5 billion freezing order against hackers behind crypto's largest theft
crypto-web3.summary: Binance obtained a $6.5 billion freezing order against perpetrators of the cryptocurrency industry's largest theft, with the exchange already replacing stolen assets using its own funds and insurance reserves. The enforcement action marks a significant step in recovering losses from the breach and deterring future attacks.

crypto-web3.title: CFTC Chair Selig outlines how Hyperliquid and other onchain venues could enter the US
crypto-web3.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig outlined two regulatory pathways for decentralized exchanges like Hyperliquid to operate in the U.S. retail market while adhering to the same compliance requirements as traditional centralized platforms. The guidance provides critical clarity for onchain trading venues seeking legitimate market access.

crypto-web3.title: US launches cybercrime center with TRM Labs to help trace crypto tied to scams
crypto-web3.summary: The United States established a Threat Disruption Center in partnership with blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs to assist law enforcement in tracing cryptocurrency transactions linked to scams and identifying criminal wallets. The initiative represents a coordinated governmental effort to combat crypto-related cybercrime and recover victim funds.

crypto-web3.title: Trump's Democratic SEC pick suggests tokenization policy deserves full rule process
crypto-web3.summary: During a Senate Banking Committee confirmation hearing, the Democratic nominee for SEC pick indicated that cryptocurrency tokenization policy warrants a comprehensive regulatory rule-making process rather than ad-hoc guidance. The statement signals a potential policy direction as the administration reconstitutes market regulatory agencies.

crypto-web3.title: Tokenized Stocks Shrug Off the Crypto Selloff
crypto-web3.summary: Tokenized stocks crossed $4 billion in onchain value for the first time in mid-November, demonstrating resilience amid crypto market volatility that pushed Bitcoin to its lowest levels in six weeks. The asset class has appreciated approximately five-fold since the start of 2026, tracking equity prices rather than cryptocurrency performance.

crypto-web3.title: Coinbase backs CFTC proposal to distinguish prediction market contracts from gambling
crypto-web3.summary: Coinbase endorsed the CFTC's proposal to explicitly classify event contracts as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act, arguing this designation provides clearer regulatory certainty and distinguishes legitimate prediction markets from gambling. The position supports expanded regulatory clarity for the emerging prediction market sector.

crypto-web3.title: Bitcoin hits four-month low after Anthropic's IPO as tech stocks wilt
crypto-web3.summary: Bitcoin declined to a four-month low as the Anthropic IPO and broader technology sector weakness pressured cryptocurrency markets, with Nasdaq futures falling below their 200-day moving average. The dual headwinds signal broader market concerns affecting risk assets across equities and digital assets.

crypto-web3.title: Crypto traders vs. Wall Street: OKX's Anthropic markets put IPO pricing to the test
crypto-web3.summary: OKX announced plans to launch tokenized Anthropic shares, with its pre-IPO futures trading approximately 24% above the company's $83 offering price at IPO launch. The discrepancy highlights how crypto exchange price discovery mechanisms can diverge from traditional IPO valuations.

crypto-web3.title: Ant International launches protocol for real-time settlement between tokenized deposits and money market funds
crypto-web3.summary: Ant International unveiled the Whale Orchestration Protocol to facilitate real-time settlement between tokenized bank deposits and tokenized money market funds, expanding infrastructure for traditional finance-crypto integration. The development advances cross-asset tokenization settlement capabilities in the digital finance ecosystem.

startups-vc.title: The Top 10 Metrics From Anthropic's IPO for B2B Execs: $33 Billion in Nine Months, 900% NRR, and 12x More $100K Customers in a Year
startups-vc.summary: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals extraordinary growth metrics, with revenue reaching $4.585 billion in 2024 and $33.24 billion in the first nine months of 2025, representing approximately 1,200% year-over-year growth. The company achieved a 900% net revenue retention rate and increased $100K+ customer accounts by 12x in a single year, establishing benchmark metrics for AI-driven B2B companies.

startups-vc.title: Anthropic Closes Up 17% After Massive IPO
startups-vc.summary: Anthropic completed a highly anticipated IPO with strong investor demand that significantly exceeded capital-raising goals, closing up 17% on its first day of trading. The offering marks a major milestone for the AI sector and positions the Claude creator as a leading player in the competitive generative AI market.

startups-vc.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
startups-vc.summary: Corba, an AI-powered cybersecurity startup, achieved unicorn status in approximately three months after launching its product, raising a $125 million Series A led by NEA. The rapid valuation milestone reflects significant investor appetite for AI-native security solutions.

startups-vc.title: 20VC x SaaStr: Jensen Out at Nvidia, Anthropic's $1.4 Trillion IPO, and HubSpot Brings Back Brian Halligan
startups-vc.summary: This week's major technology news includes significant leadership changes at Nvidia, Anthropic's landmark IPO, and strategic management decisions at HubSpot, alongside broader industry themes including LP focus on $20B+ outcomes and emerging market fragility risks. The digest covers transformative moments in enterprise software and AI investment.

startups-vc.title: Former Alibaba exec's Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
startups-vc.summary: Everful has secured $48.5 million in funding to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform that connects retailers with overseas manufacturers in China. The capital will support growth in the cross-border B2B commerce space, leveraging the founding team's experience from Alibaba.

startups-vc.title: 5 Interesting Learnings from the Databricks AI Index: Open-Weight Jumps to 31% of Enterprise Tokens, 72% of Companies Now Use Multiple Model Providers, and a 281x Gap Between Median and Power Users
startups-vc.summary: Databricks' AI Index, based on actual token traffic from over 10,000 companies including Fortune 500 firms, reveals that open-weight models now account for 31% of enterprise tokens and 72% of companies utilize multiple AI model providers. The data shows a significant 281x performance gap between median and power users, indicating substantial variance in AI deployment maturity.

startups-vc.title: What's Next For Recruiting, Job Hunting And HR? More AI, Of Course
startups-vc.summary: Venture capital deployed nearly $4 billion into recruiting, job search, and HR/payroll management companies globally this year, with the vast majority incorporating AI-powered features. The funding surge reflects investor confidence in AI-driven automation of workforce management processes.

startups-vc.title: KeyBanc's 2026 AI x Software Survey: 24% Median ARR Growth, Only 6% at the Rule of 40, and 43% of Vendors Watching Customers Vibe Code Their Product
startups-vc.summary: KeyBanc Capital Markets' 17th edition software benchmark survey reveals that private B2B software companies achieve a 24% median annual recurring revenue growth rate, with only 6% meeting Rule of 40 performance standards. The survey's expanded AI section shows that 43% of vendors report customers building custom replacements for their products.

startups-vc.title: The Blue Economy: The World's Quietest Economic Engine And Its Smartest Cities
startups-vc.summary: The $2.6 trillion blue economy is generating startup opportunities in maritime automation, clean energy, and logistics, with blue tech funding reaching nearly $10 billion through Q3 2026. Ports are emerging as innovation hubs for testing and scaling these technologies, though realizing their potential requires coordinated efforts among port authorities, startups, investors, and policymakers.

startups-vc.title: Public Markets Are Frequently Wrong. The SaaSpocalypse Shows Us Why
startups-vc.summary: The SaaSpocalypse selloff and recovery exposed public markets' difficulty distinguishing between AI-advantaged and AI-threatened software companies, with deeply embedded platforms retaining competitive advantages. Market volatility distorts private transaction pricing and reduces IPO appeal to founders, underscoring the disconnect between public valuations and private market activity.

energy-climate.title: Revealed: Russia, Saudi Arabia and Australia are largest CO2 exporters of all time
energy-climate.summary: A new analysis identifies Russia, Saudi Arabia, and Australia as the world's largest historical exporters of carbon dioxide emissions, highlighting the disproportionate contribution of fossil fuel-producing nations to global greenhouse gas pollution. The findings underscore the carbon intensity of these economies and their role in driving climate change through energy exports.

energy-climate.title: China and Türkiye sign $15bn MoU for wind and solar projects at COP31
energy-climate.summary: China and Turkey have announced a preliminary agreement for Beijing to invest up to $15 billion in constructing solar and wind power facilities in Turkey, representing a major commitment to renewable energy development at the COP31 climate summit. The deal signals significant momentum for international clean energy cooperation and investment.

energy-climate.title: Oman signs green hydrogen deals at COP31 in Türkiye
energy-climate.summary: Oman has awarded two integrated green hydrogen projects in Duqm with combined planned annual production capacity of approximately 121,000 metric tons by 2032, announced at COP31. The projects represent significant progress in developing hydrogen as a clean energy vector for hard-to-decarbonize sectors.

energy-climate.title: Interactive: Tracking negotiating texts at the COP31 climate summit
energy-climate.summary: Carbon Brief provides an interactive tool for tracking the evolving negotiating texts and legal frameworks being developed at the COP31 climate summit, enabling stakeholders to follow real-time progress on key climate policy agreements. The resource serves as a comprehensive resource for monitoring international climate negotiations.

energy-climate.title: Indonesia could reach 96.7 GW of solar by 2029 with policy reforms
energy-climate.summary: According to the Institute for Essential Services Reform, Indonesia could achieve nearly its entire 100 GW solar capacity target by 2029 through coordinated utility-scale procurement, rooftop deployment, and rural electrification programs, though regulatory and grid infrastructure barriers must first be addressed. The analysis identifies policy pathways for rapid renewable energy expansion in Southeast Asia's largest economy.

energy-climate.title: Google signs 50-MW superhot geothermal PPA with Quaise Energy
energy-climate.summary: Google has signed a power purchase agreement for 50 megawatts of superhot geothermal energy from Quaise Energy to support its Oregon data center operations beginning as early as 2030. The deal advances development of innovative deep geothermal technology that could unlock vast untapped renewable energy resources for large-scale industrial applications.

energy-climate.title: Tesla seeks Texas tax break for $3.1 billion polysilicon plant
energy-climate.summary: Tesla is pursuing a property tax incentive from Texas for a $3.1 billion polysilicon manufacturing facility aimed at producing solar's most critical material domestically, reducing reliance on China-dominated global supply chains. The project represents a significant effort to build U.S. solar manufacturing capacity and supply chain resilience.

energy-climate.title: EU to launch €36 million funding call for advanced solar cell manufacturing
energy-climate.summary: The European Union is launching a €36 million funding initiative to support development of high-efficiency solar cells, advanced manufacturing equipment, and automated production processes to strengthen Europe's domestic solar manufacturing capacity. The program targets industrial-scale pilot production to reduce technological and economic barriers to continental solar expansion.

energy-climate.title: MicroQuanta, Zhejiang University achieve world-record efficiency of 23.9% for 19.48 cm² perovskite solar module
energy-climate.summary: MicroQuanta and Zhejiang University have achieved a world-record 23.9% efficiency rating for a perovskite solar module, certified by China's National PV Industry Measurement and Testing Center. The breakthrough demonstrates significant progress in next-generation photovoltaic technology that could enhance solar deployment efficiency and economics.

energy-climate.title: Jackery and Every Electric launch 4 MWh plug-in battery VPP for New York renters
energy-climate.summary: Jackery has partnered with Brooklyn-based aggregator Every Electric to deploy a 4-megawatt-hour plug-in battery virtual power plant designed to manage air-conditioning load peaks for New York renters without additional permitting requirements. The project demonstrates innovative approaches to distributed energy resources and demand-side management in urban residential settings.

asia-pacific.title: ICJ Delivers Historic Verdict: Myanmar Guilty of Genocide Against the Rohingya
asia-pacific.summary: The International Court of Justice has delivered a landmark ruling finding Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya minority, determining that security forces killed thousands of civilians and committed widespread sexual violence and extreme violence against children. This historic verdict carries significant implications for international humanitarian law and accountability in the Asia-Pacific region.

asia-pacific.title: China-Russia-US trilateral summit declaration towards peace
asia-pacific.summary: Presidents Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin held a historic trilateral summit in Shenzhen, issuing a joint declaration addressing UN reform, global energy supply, sovereign immunity, and nuclear risk reduction. The summit represents a significant diplomatic development with major implications for regional stability and international relations.

asia-pacific.title: China, Russia, US Talk UN Reform, Nuclear Risks, and Ukraine at Trilateral Summit
asia-pacific.summary: The trilateral summit between China, Russia, and the United States in Shenzhen addressed critical geopolitical issues including UN reform, nuclear risk reduction, and Ukraine, with Chinese President Xi appearing to leverage the event strategically. The meeting underscores shifting diplomatic alignments and China's central role in great power negotiations.

asia-pacific.title: Why the ball is in Kim Jong-un's court on a meeting with Donald Trump
asia-pacific.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's absence from the APEC gathering in Shenzhen signals a potential impasse in diplomatic talks with the United States, contrasting sharply with Trump's first term when the leaders met three times. Analysts note that Kim appears focused on consolidating nuclear weapons capabilities rather than pursuing immediate negotiations.

asia-pacific.title: At APEC, Lee Urges Asia-Pacific Leaders to Back Talks With North Korea
asia-pacific.summary: South Korean President Lee made an appeal to Asia-Pacific leaders at the APEC summit in Shenzhen to support diplomatic engagement with North Korea. The call reflects Seoul's efforts to build international coalition support for de-escalation and dialogue on the Korean Peninsula.

asia-pacific.title: China Ratchets Up Its Weaponization of Trade
asia-pacific.summary: China is significantly expanding its export control system in ways that exceed the scope of comparable U.S. mechanisms, using trade restrictions as a strategic geopolitical tool. This escalation has implications for regional and global supply chains and international economic competition.

asia-pacific.title: Takaichi Meets Putin a Day After Suspected Russian Aircraft Violate Japanese Airspace
asia-pacific.summary: Japanese officials met with Russian President Putin amid reported incursions of Russian military aircraft into Japanese airspace, raising concerns about Moscow's strategic posture toward Japan and Taiwan. The timing suggests escalating tensions and unclear messaging from Russia regarding its Asia-Pacific intentions.

asia-pacific.title: Russia, Japan, and the Race to Power a Nuclear Indonesia
asia-pacific.summary: Russia and Japan are competing to establish nuclear partnerships with Indonesia, with significant implications for Southeast Asian energy security and geopolitical alignment. Jakarta's selection of international nuclear partners will shape the region's technological development and strategic orientation.

asia-pacific.title: Financial Street Securities says chairman detained and under investigation on mainland
asia-pacific.summary: The chairman of Hong Kong-listed mainland Chinese brokerage Financial Street Securities has been detained and placed under investigation by Beijing authorities as part of a sweeping anti-corruption campaign. The case reflects ongoing concerns about financial sector governance and regulatory uncertainty in China.

asia-pacific.title: Malaysia's military eyes gamers for South China Sea drone surveillance
asia-pacific.summary: Malaysia's military is exploring recruitment of young gamers and digital specialists to enhance its drone surveillance capabilities for South China Sea operations. The initiative reflects regional militarization efforts and the increasing strategic importance of unmanned technology in maritime security.
